query: For my 91-year-old male, among men aged 86–96 with UGIB and COPD exacerbation, what's the average hospital length of stay?
final_sql: SELECT AVG(icustays.los) AS average_length_of_stay FROM patients JOIN admissions ON patients.subject_id = admissions.subject_id JOIN icustays ON admissions.stay_id = icustays.stay_id WHERE patients.gender = 'M' AND patients.anchor_age = 91 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM admissions.admittime) BETWEEN 2019 AND 2020 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM diagnoses_icd WHERE diagnoses_icd.subject_id = patients.subject_id AND diagnoses_icd.icd_code IN ('UGIB', 'COPD')) AND (icustays.intime - admissions.admittime) BETWEEN 0 AND 10000;
